heard: A single star cloud in Andromeda contains hundreds of supergiants. Astronomer William Herschel first spotted this strange hazy patch through his telescope. It appeared as a very large nebulosity. It did not look like a tiny point of light. John Herschel mapped its massive scale later on. This colossal nursery sits right inside our neighbor galaxy. Hundreds of supergiants filled that single star cloud in Andromeda.
